Smart BX3 Pro 650W
Equipped with a high-quality 105°C main capacitor, it ensures outstanding durability and consistent performance even under high temperatures. With comprehensive protection mechanisms and a 5-year warranty, the Smart BX3 Pro 650W is designed to deliver dependable performance and long-lasting value for users who demand efficiency and reliability.
Built for Intel ATX 3.1 Standard
The Smart BX3 Pro 650W fully complies with the Intel ATX 3.1 specification, supporting Intel C6/C7 low power states and ErP readiness for enhanced energy efficiency. It delivers 650W of continuous power at 40°C, meeting strict power timing standards to ensure system stability and full compatibility with modern PC builds.
PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready
With a native PCIe Gen 5.1 12V-2×6 connector and low-profile etched flat cables, the Smart BX3 Pro 650W ensures better airflow and easier cable management for modern GPUs. Its high-amperage +12 V rail, high-quality 105°C main capacitor, and DC-to-DC design delivers stable and efficient power to meet next-gen performance demands.

Industry-Grade Safety Protections
Built-in protections including Over Current Protection (OCP), Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage Protection (UVP), Over Power Protection (OPP), Over Temperature Protection (OTP), and Short Circuit Protection (SCP) safeguards your system against electrical faults, providing peace of mind and reliable operation.

80 PLUS® Bronze Efficiency
Certified for 80 PLUS® Bronze with up to 85% efficiency, the Smart BX3 Pro 650W delivers continuous and stable power output at 40 °C. It minimizes energy loss and enhances system performance, making it a reliable and efficient choice for modern PC builds.
Compact Size for Easy Installation
With a compact design of 150mm (W) x 86mm (H) x 140mm (D), the Smart BX3 Pro 650W fits seamlessly into most PC cases. Its standard ATX dimensions make installation simple and space-efficient, providing users with a clean, organized build layout without compromising power performance.
